## Our Craft & Commitment


GRVMZ is built on the belief that style should be expressive, inclusive, and responsible. We design for the everyday runway — pieces that move with you, made with materials that respect the planet.










### Unisex Silhouettes


Fluid fits designed for every body. Our collections blur the lines between women's and men's fashion, focusing on structure, comfort, and confidence that transcends labels.











### Eco-Conscious Materials


From organic cotton to recycled poly blends, we source fabrics that feel good on the skin and are kinder to the earth. Every thread is a choice towards a cleaner future.











### Digital-First Storytelling


Our online boutique brings the lookbook to life. Immersive visuals and editorial narratives connect you directly with the vision behind every drop, making your shopping experience as rich as the garments themselves.
































## Day to NightSilhouettes


GRVMZ captures the rhythm of the street with layered essentials that move from morning light to after-dark energy. Each piece is cut for motion, built for expression, and designed to be worn, not just seen.




















### Expressive Details


Hand-finished embroidery, raw hems, and considered hardware turn everyday staples into signature pieces.

















## What Our Community Says


Real style, real confidence. Hear from the GRVMZ family.










### The Urban Creative


“GRVMZ isn't just a clothing brand; it's a statement. The fit is impeccable, and the fabrics feel like they were made for movement. I've never felt more confident walking into a meeting or a gallery opening.”


— Marcus J.







### The Conscious Stylist


“Finding a brand that balances streetwear edge with ethical production is rare. GRVMZ does it effortlessly. The versatility across their men's and women's lines means I can style pieces for literally any shoot.”


— Elena R.







### The Modern Minimalist


“Finally, a fashion boutique online that understands structure and simplicity. The silhouettes are timeless, but the details are so now. My wardrobe has never looked this cohesive.”


— David K.

# The GRVMZ Origin


Born from the rhythm of the city and the pulse of the street, GRVMZ /KLōTHING/ BRAND is more than a label — it's a cultural statement. We create apparel that bridges the gap between urban edge and conscious craftsmanship, offering a distinct visual identity for those who move with intention.


Our journey began with a simple ambition: to build a direct relationship with our community. We saw a space where authenticity was being replaced by algorithm-driven fast fashion. GRVMZ exists to reclaim that space, delivering carefully constructed pieces that speak to both women and men who value substance over trends. Every stitch, every silhouette, and every campaign image is a chapter in our ongoing story of self-expression.

Explore the Collection

























## Our Values


GRVMZ is built on a foundation of expressive design, responsible sourcing, and inclusive style. We believe clothing should empower every body and respect every resource.





Products










### Expressive Design


We craft garments that speak before you do. Each piece is a canvas for urban culture, blending bold editorial aesthetics with wearable comfort for the modern wardrobe.





### Responsible Sourcing


Mindful from fiber to finish. We partner with suppliers who share our commitment to ethical practices, reducing environmental impact without compromising on quality or style.





### Inclusive Style


Fashion without boundaries. Our collections are designed for women and men across sizes and silhouettes, celebrating individuality and the confidence that comes with a perfect fit.



























## From Street to Stitch


Every GRVMZ piece begins in the raw energy of city culture and the quiet intensity of fabric exploration. We translate movement, texture, and attitude into apparel built for repeat wear — clothing that lives as hard as you do.





01


### Concept & Culture


We walk the streets, absorb the rhythm, and capture the unspoken style codes that define modern urban identity. Each collection starts as a mood board of real moments — concrete textures, transit lines, late-night neon — filtered through a lens of intentional design.





02


### Material Consideration


Fabric isn't an afterthought — it's the foundation. We source heavyweight cottons, structured twills, and eco-conscious blends that hold their shape after countless wears. Every textile is hand-tested for drape, durability, and the way it moves with the body.





03


### Finishing Mindset


Details separate good from unforgettable. Double-stitched seams, reinforced stress points, custom hardware, and garment-dyed finishes give each piece a lived-in character from day one. We don't chase trends — we build wardrobe staples that age beautifully.



















## What the culture is saying






### "It feels like a fashion boutique online, but with real soul."


GRVMZ doesn't just sell clothes — they build a visual language. The consistency from their lookbooks to the actual pieces is something you rarely see in independent labels. Every drop feels intentional, and the quality speaks louder than any ad campaign.


— Jordan E., Stylist





### "Finally, men's clothing stores that understand proportion."


I've been searching for brands that bridge streetwear comfort with refined tailoring, and GRVMZ gets the balance exactly right. The fits are modern without being trendy, and the fabric choices show real care for how clothes actually move on a body.


— Marcus T., Creative Director













## Ready to Wear the Culture?


GRVMZ isn't just fabric and thread. It's a statement. A movement. A connection between the city's pulse and conscious creation. Whether you have a question about our latest drop, want to collaborate, or simply need styling advice that breaks the mold — our doors are always open. Let's start a conversation and build the next chapter of your wardrobe together.

Lookbook / Vol. 01

# Urban Layering. Sharp Silhouettes.


### Expressive essentials for women and men. A study in contrast, texture, and movement — where street culture meets considered craft.

Explore The Collection














## The Lookbook


Editorial stills capturing the full GRVMZ vision. Full outfits, detail crops, texture moments, and street context — a visual essay, not a sales catalog.








Full silhouette — The elongated trench





Texture study — Woven earth





Street context — Movement





Details — Collar & contrast





Golden hour — Denim study





Panorama — The collective






GRVMZ isn't just about the garment — it's about the moment it lives in. Each frame is a study in texture, silhouette, and the raw energy of the street. Discover the full collection at our online fashion boutique.














## Style Notes


The GRVMZ approach to dressing isn't about rules—it's about intention. Our seasonal editorial breaks down three core principles that define how we build a modern wardrobe.






### 01. The Art of Layering


Proportion is everything. Start with a close-to-body base in a neutral tone, then build outward with exaggerated silhouettes—an oversized shirt jacket over a slim knit, or a cropped boxy tee over a longline tank. The tension between fitted and oversized creates the editorial look you see on the streets of the best fashion boutique online.









### 02. Fit Attitude


Confidence drives the silhouette. Whether you prefer the relaxed drape of our wide-leg trousers or the sharp precision of a tailored blazer, the key is owning the space you occupy. We design for both men's and women's bodies with a unisex sensibility that echoes the best men's clothing stores but feels entirely fresh. The fit should make you stand a little taller.









### 03. Statement + Everyday


One piece should do the talking. Pair a bold printed camp shirt with clean black denim, or let an exaggerated trench coat anchor a simple white tee and trouser combination. This mix of statement and staple pieces keeps your look grounded yet memorable—a philosophy we share with iconic labels like Tommy Hilfiger clothing but filtered through a contemporary, eco-conscious lens.

## Frequently Asked Questions




### What types of inquiries can I send through the contact page?


You can reach out about sizing, order changes, custom requests, collaboration proposals, or general brand questions. We read every message and route it to the right team member.




### How quickly can I expect a response from GRVMZ?


Our team typically replies within 24–48 hours on business days. During new collection launches or sale events, response windows may extend slightly, but we always prioritize urgent order-related messages.




### Is GRVMZ open to creative collaborations or wholesale partnerships?


Absolutely. We love working with stylists, photographers, and like-minded brands. Use the contact form and select "Collaboration" as your subject — our creative team reviews these personally.




### How do I stay updated on brand news and product drops?


The best way is to follow our social channels and check the journal section of the site. For early access, sign up for the newsletter — subscribers often receive first looks at limited releases.

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 6/9/2026



At GRVMZ /KLōTHING/ BRAND, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: [business_email]


Phone: [business_phone]


Address: [business_address]

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  6/9/2026



GRVMZ /KLōTHING/ BRAND ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  June 9, 2026



GRVMZ /KLōTHING/ BRAND is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: GRVMZ /KLōTHING/ BRAND

- Email: [business_email]

- Phone: [business_phone]



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.
